notes: Evaluates /cadence-interview contracts: unrecognized flag refusal, missing live CADENCE_ORG.md fail-closed halt, Where/Who/Why scope containment (§7-§15 byte-preserved), non-destructive N/A retention, default idempotent no-op, and Step 7 disk re-read post-write check.

evals.name: unrecognized-flag-and-missing-org-halt
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-interview --reinterview in a repo with CADENCE_ORG.md present (and separately run /cadence-interview where CADENCE_ORG.md is missing).
evals.expected_output: Halts immediately on misspelled flag --reinterview citing unrecognized argument instead of falling back to default mode; halts when live docs/agentic-sdlc/CADENCE_ORG.md is absent without synthesizing it.
assertions: Halts fail-closed on unrecognized flag without defaulting to default mode
Halts when docs/agentic-sdlc/CADENCE_ORG.md does not exist without synthesizing the file

evals.name: non-destructive-na-and-post-write-self-check
evals.prompt: Fill placeholders in Where/Who/Why selecting N/A on one row and Observed candidate on another while leaving §15 intact.
evals.expected_output: Writes literal N/A keeping the table row intact (preserving column 1 and Notes), leaves §7-§15 and CADENCE_ORG_TEMPLATE.md byte-identical, re-reads CADENCE_ORG.md from disk in Step 7 confirming row counts preserved and zero placeholders in populated cells (UNSOUND_CONDITION on structural corruption).
assertions: Preserves table rows when N/A is selected instead of deleting rows
Restricts edits strictly to second-column value cells under Where/Who/Why leaving §7-§15 untouched
Re-reads CADENCE_ORG.md from disk in Step 7 verifying row counts, scope containment, and residual placeholders
